definitions.full: H6325. Punon מּוּנֹן proper name, of a location 2nd station of Israel from Hor Num 33:42-43 , Φ ( ε ) ινω ; between Petra and Zoar, famous for mines, Greek Φινων , Φαινων Euseb Onom. ed. Lag. 299, 85 , see also Ritter Erdkunde, Asien. xiv, 125 ff. Seetzen :Reise iii, 17 ( Kálaét Phenân ); perhaps = Edomite proper name, masculine מִּינֹן q. v.
